params.name: brief
params.description: Return brief response with reduced detail.

items.docs: Returns the overall health status of the Cilium daemon including connectivity to the kvstore, container runtime, Kubernetes API server, and the status of each configured subsystem.
Returns the current runtime configuration of the Cilium daemon, including mutable and immutable settings such as policy enforcement mode, enabled features, and address pool information.
Modifies the mutable runtime configuration of the Cilium daemon. Supports updating policy enforcement mode and feature toggles without restarting the agent.

params.name: client-id
params.description: Unique client ID for long-polling. Returns only changes since the last response to this client.

items.docs: Returns information about all nodes in the Cilium cluster, including their addresses, health status, and connectivity information.
Returns comprehensive debugging information about the Cilium daemon, including BPF map state, policy state, endpoint information, and environment details useful for troubleshooting.
Returns a list of all open BPF maps used by the Cilium datapath, including their names, types, key/value sizes, and current entry counts.
Returns the mapping of node names to their allocated numeric node IDs used in the BPF datapath for traffic identification and policy enforcement.
